summary: No findings. The Randomise line-up button (src/ui/config/GameConfigScreen.tsx:75) draws one Uint32 per bot seat from globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues, a CSPRNG. No Math.random exists anywhere in src. randomBotStyles (src/table/session.ts:206-221) maps each word with w % BOT_STYLES.length. There are 4 styles and 2^32 is a multiple of 4, so the mapping is exactly uniform. It also rejects any word that is not an integer in 0..2^32-1 with a RangeError, which fails closed. The draw uses its own 1-word buffer per call. It shares no state with newReplayCode (src/engine/deck.ts, a separate 4-word buffer) or the seeded Xoshiro deck, so it cannot affect deck order or replay codes. The drawn styles reach SessionConfig only through configWithSeatStyles -> configWithSeatStyle, which still checks each style against BOT_STYLES and the seat against the preset. Only a click triggers the draw, and the user cannot seed or influence it. The change adds no dependencies, storage, network calls or logging.
